Class CalendarTest

  • java.lang.Object
    • CalendarTest
  • public class CalendarTest
extends java.lang.Object
    Unit tests for the ICalendar model. This class contains test cases to verify the correct behavior of the ICalendar interface and its implementations, such as event management, calendar state handling, and interaction with other components.
